title: A business feature (a record and its add-ons)

name.x-prompt: What is the feature called (plural, kebab-case: invoices)?

path.description: The folder the feature goes in (default <sourceRoot>/features).

webRoot.description: The web app's src from the same root (apps/web/src): also write the feature's web pages. `pnpm feature:add` passes it.

flat.description: Write the files into `path` itself, not into `path/<name>`.

skipImport.description: Do not add the module to src/app.module.ts.

singular.description: The singular, when it cannot be derived (people: person).

fields.description: name:type, comma-separated; types string, text, int, decimal, money, bool, date, datetime, enum(a|b), json, ref(<feature>); ? optional, !unique unique, !unique(otherId) unique within another field, !numbered filled from a naming series when left empty.

addons.description: Add-ons, comma-separated, or all: the modules with a <name>.addon.js (src/modules; an unknown name lists them).
addons.x-prompt: Add-ons, comma-separated, or all (tags, comments, attachments, revisions, favorites, recents, templates, choices, custom-fields, computed-fields, approvals, acknowledgments, bulk, merge, data-transfer, data-quality, shares, documents, ai, automations, sequences, webhooks, notifications, recurrence, retention; empty for none):

softDelete.description: A recycle bin: deleted records are restorable until purged.

unit.description: Records carry their creator's organizational unit (unit leads read their units').
unit.x-prompt: Organizational units (unit leads see their units' records)?

clientAccess.description: API clients create, read, change and delete their own records.

grants.description: The seed roles' grants: standard (editors their own, viewers all) or none (administrators only).

idempotency.description: The create route's Idempotency-Key (default: the deployment's IDEMPOTENCY).

approvals.description: With the approvals add-on: the actions that need approval, comma-separated camelCase (publish, markPaid).

sourceRoot.description: The project's source root (Nest's CLI passes it).
